title: RAW UNREVIEWED: a resulting condition belongs to an entered recipient while a manufactured product requires a separate object entry
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_UNTESTED_SPECULATIVE. A complete account may administer or act on an entered recipient and then name its resulting condition, rather than create a new material product. A contrasting account manufactures an output entity and deposits or uses it. Independent recipient/result typing can distinguish these branches without assigning arbitrary disease or material names.

design.mechanism: Recipient branch: enter R, perform a written action on R, and assert RESULT_STATE(R,P,episode), with any later condition predicate still owned by R. Product branch: enter an input, perform a producing action, explicitly enter output O with provenance, and direct the later consumer to O. State ownership and produced-object identity are distinct typed results; neither is inherited from input qualities.
design.unit: Two complete already-owned contexts nominated prospectively, with every group and alternative preserved. Independent recipient/substrate/result owner evidence must be frozen before new lexical values; producer does not read target bodies.
design.contrast: Recipient-owned result state versus newly produced material/entity, with purpose-only outcome as a retained third possibility. A result-shaped nominal does not by itself prove successful change or new-object creation.
design.prediction: Freeze result sorts and all primitive values before a paired whole reading. In the state branch the written result and later condition must share an independently entered recipient and episode; in the product branch a paid output entry/provenance must supply the consumer. If only a purpose is written, neither completed result is asserted. Every group contributes or remains UNKNOWN; no automatic state/product coercion from fluent English.
design.scope: Speculative result-ownership approach only; no medical efficacy claim, new physiology/material gloss, inherited quality, latest-nominal fallback or repeat portion/result census.

missing_inputs: Complete prospective paired contexts with candidate action/result/later-consumer contributions
Independent typed recipient and result ownership from already admitted evidence
Written distinction among result-state assertion, produced-output entry and mere purpose
Verified complete historical clauses for the proposed result sorts before scientific selection
required_falsifier: Reject if recipient state is supplied only by an unentered owner, if output identity is invented from a result noun, if a purpose becomes an achieved result without a written assertion, or if fixed result typing cannot consume the whole second context.
retained_caveats: 565 recipient-conditioned construction remains nonconfirming;343/344complete-target gaps stay open.

exact_changed_research_decision: Offers independently owned recipient state as a whole-account alternative to deposited material output; selection requires a written result owner and consumer rather than another noun gloss.
